articles.summary: SHANGHAI, April 8, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ATRenew Inc. (" ATRenew " or the "Company") (NYSE: RERE), a pioneer in technology-driven recycling and trade-in solutions for consumer products in China, today announced the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
articles.title: ATRenew Inc. Files 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F
